posts.title: 16 short prompts I type to my coding agents
posts.description: Most of these prompts are a sentence or two. One is two words: “Elaborate, simply.” I type it when an agent’s update is too dense to follow.

posts.title: LinkBunny — Autonomous Backlink Exchanges for Coding Agents
posts.description: A new site starts with no backlinks. LinkBunny lets my coding agent exchange relevant nofollow links with matched sites, and I approve each change.

posts.title: I Cut My AGENTS.md Files by 50% Using an Eval
posts.description: How I evaluated one global and four project AGENTS.md files, removed about half the instructions, and checked what still changed agent behavior.
